summary: Everyone knows these films and the Blitz is deep. Lives go fast on equally famous films just below #10 (Jurassic World #11, Barbie #13), which keeps scores near 6 or 7.
reasons: Casual found 8 by guess 9, then lost all 5 lives on bare 'star wars' (the 1977 film, #30), Barbie #13, The Lion King #20, Jurassic World #11 and Frozen #58; 'infinity war' (#9) never got played. The fan also ran out of lives, at 9/10.
Bare 'spiderman' and 'avengers' are ranked films too (#53, #16) and cost a life while those franchises hold four top-10 spots. Honest, but it is how most casual players will lose their first life.

Spider-Man: Brand New Day is a fresh #1 that players in November will know, so careful players can reach 9. Run it before Avengers: Doomsday opens on 2026-12-18, or rebuild first. Blitz: 22 of 22 quick names scored.
fixes: Source row #41, The Lion King (1994, $424,979,720), is missing from the build because it shares its title with #20, the 2019 remake. Every built rank from #41 to #99 is one place above the source (Frozen shows #58, Wikipedia #59) and 'lion king 1994' is not recognized. Keep both films as separate entries told apart by year.

Add to junkAliases (Titanic): 'Titanic 4 Disc', 'Titanic 5-disc Deluxe Limited Edition', 'Titanic Special Edition DVD', 'Titanic Five Disc Deluxe Limited Edition'. They are home-video editions, not names of the film.
Add aliases 'Avatar 3' (Avatar: Fire and Ash) and 'Infinity Wars' (Avengers: Infinity War): common ways to type them, currently not recognized (free, so minor).
